title: Whose wife is it anyway? Assessing bias against same-gender relationships in machine translation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating template sentences about romantic relationships in noun-gender languages (French, Italian, Spanish) using male/female occupation nouns and relationship targets (e.g., boyfriend/girlfriend). Machine translation accuracy is evaluated by checking if the English output correctly preserves the source subject's gender via possessive pronouns for same-gender versus different-gender couples.

Using logistic regression to analyze how demographic variables associated with the occupations in the template sentences (median income, median age, and female representation) correlate with the machine translation accuracy of same-gender relationship sentences.
Comparing translation accuracy and pronoun prediction error rates between male same-gender relationships and female same-gender relationships across various occupations.
